thread:
alex: Kicking off blue/green traffic gate for release v2.14 now. Change window 60m. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with holds. Pin a small cohort to v2.13 for a fast rollback path. @meera can you confirm LB cookie TTL and session affinity settings?
meera: Ack. Current cookie TTL 30s. Will set to 10s during shift to reduce sticky sessions. Also lowering cookie scope to /api only.
sarah: Release notes pushed: https://go/release-notes/v2.14 — includes model + runtime perf fixes and a note about KV cache invalidation behavior.
deploy-bot: shadow-warmup started for service=frontdoor env=prod target=v2.14 replicas=4
oncall-sre: I'll watch p95, error-rate, and 5xx count. Thresholds: error-rate >3% OR p95 >500ms for 2m -> abort. I've started a watch runbook.
alex: Pin strategy: mark 10% of sessions pinned to v2.13 (pin-label: rollback-cohort). If we need to abort we drain new traffic and direct pinned sessions to v2.13 ASAP.
meera: Pinned instance list updated: router-prod-a:2 (v2.13 pinned), router-prod-b:3 (v2.13 pinned). Config snippet applied: ```yaml
load_balancer:
  session_cookie_ttl: 10
  cookie_path: /api
  stickiness: Enabled
  pin_label: rollback-cohort
```
mike: Ops decision: if error-rate >3% OR 5xx spike >50rps for >2m we run rollback-quick. Rollback steps in runbook: 1) set traffic gate to 0% to v2.14 2) re-enable pinned nodes 3) verify green lane health.
deploy-bot: Starting gradual shift: stage=canary percent=10 -> initiating
deploy-bot: shift complete: stage=canary percent=10 took 35s
oncall-sre: Observability check @ 3m: p95=210ms, error-rate=0.4%, 5xx=4rps. All green.
alex: Proceed to 50% step after 10m hold. Noted hold timer started.
meera: Confirmed cookie TTL change is live on load-balancer edge.
deploy-bot: Starting shift to 50% -> progress logs: 
- 10% -> 25% -> 50% (step increments 5m)
- health hooks firing OK
deploy-bot: shift complete: stage=midgate percent=50
oncall-sre: 6m into 50% hold: p95=240ms, error-rate=0.7%, 5xx=6rps. Still under thresholds. Watching for slow tail.
mike: Quick note: metrics show a small spike in DB tail for some write paths. If that grows beyond 10% latency we abort.
sarah: Updated release notes with migration note and rollback cohort details. Link: https://go/release-notes/v2.14#rollbacks
alex: If we see sustained error-rate >1.5% for 5m we prepare manual abort. Otherwise continue to 100% after the 10m hold.
deploy-bot: initiating final ramp to 100%: target_percent=100
deploy-bot: shift complete: stage=final percent=100
oncall-sre: Post-cutover checks: p95=260ms, error-rate=0.9%, 5xx=7rps. No threshold breaches.
meera: Reverting cookie TTL to default 30s now that cutover is complete.
mike: Removing pin on rollback-cohort in 10m to allow capacity reclaim.
sarah: Posting final release note and tagging product. Everyone please add any post-cutover followups to the doc.
alex: Cutover success. Thanks folks. Closing the gate and leaving the thread open for any follow ups. :tada:
